nativeBrowserParity.scope: Every subset of all nine currently buildable frontend modules, with hidden stock FX2 and the current retained-stock menus (omitting only required DSP donors).

memory.stockState: Reuses pending record 0x46c7dfda + 32*track, writing byte 15. No new state or stack allocation.

main.placementStart: After selected descriptor clones: 0x400d6b20 + 0x1a0 * cloned effect count, then preceding native-linked ROM units/caves.

romRegions.placement: Chosen after prior native-linked units/caves and checked as zero before writing; all profiles have native byte identities.

memory.authoredStackRegion: No pushes, calls or new stack frame.

limitations: No real-chip worst-case cycle count, scheduling or memory-contention headroom claim.
